In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. 532 /2026

] 
 Deel Singh Appellant(s
VERSUS  THE STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH Respondent  O R D E R Leave granted.

The appellant, who is the husband of the deceased, seeks bail in connection with FIR No.0312/2023 dated 23.10.2023, registered with Police Station Mangalpur Kanpur Dehat, District Kanpur Dehat,
for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 304B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
Admittedly, the appellant has been under incarceration for more than 2 years.
Only 6 out of 28 witnesses have been examined.
In such view of the matter, we are inclined to grant bail to the appellant.
Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside, and the appellant is granted bail on terms and conditions to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court.
The appeal stands allowed, accordingly.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
